title: EOS policy lock
description: Pins the policy in force (gates, profiles, state machines and the project declaration) by digest, and records every acknowledged change that weakens it. Written by `eos policy lock --write`; checked by `eos policy check`. A weakening needs a reason and an approver who is not the requester.

policyDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical policy snapshot. Any policy edit changes it, so an edit made without regenerating the lock fails the check.

acknowledged.description: Every policy change that needed sign-off. Kept, not pruned: this is the record of who agreed to weaken what, and why.

change.description: The change id from `eos policy diff`, including the before and after values.

reason.description: Why the change is acceptable. Fewer than 20 characters is treated as no reason.

approver.description: Empty until a second person fills it in. EOS drafts acknowledgements; it never approves them.
